The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: LoL: Kiwoom DRX vs Nongshim Red Force (BO3) - LCK Rounds 1-2

title: QatarEnergy announces/resumes LNG production in Qatar by April 30?
description:
QatarEnergy, a Qatari state-owned petroleum company, announced on March 2 that it would halt production of liquefied natural gas (LNG) due to military strikes on its operating facilities (see: https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/MediaCenter/Pages/newsdetails.aspx?ItemId=3892).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if QatarEnergy resumes production of liquefied natural gas at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar, or officially announces that such production has resumed or will resume, by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

QatarEnergy resuming the production of other halted products, including downstream LNG-related products, or resuming transportation of LNG without resuming production, will not alone count.

An official announcement that LNG production will resume at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar must signal the end of the total LNG production halt effective immediately or on a specific date or clearly defined time window. Mere statements that production will resume at some undefined point in the future, or that production will resume once the halt has ended, will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from QatarEnergy (https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/Pages/vHome.aspx); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices "Yes" at 99.7% for QatarEnergy announcing or resuming LNG production in Qatar by April 30, reflecting confidence in partial restarts at Ras Laffan facilities following a March halt due to missile attacks and force majeure declaration. A ceasefire enabled engineer mobilization by early April, with credible reports from Reuters and Upstream indicating two of three trains at QatarEnergy LNG's North 1 complex restarted mid-month, restoring limited output from the 77 million tonnes per annum capacity. Absent official QatarEnergy statements, traders weigh reporting consensus against JV partner disclosures of ongoing shutdowns. Realistic shifts could stem from renewed hostilities, verification disputes via UMA oracle, or equipment issues delaying full ramp-up.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:
This market will resolve to the country whose candidate for Eurovision 2026 wins.

If at any point it is impossible for the listed candidate to win Eurovision 2026 based on the rules of the competition (i.e. they are eliminated), this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If no winner is announced by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve "Other". All ties will be broken according to EBU's official Eurovision rules.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen lead Polymarket's Eurovision 2026 winner market at 34.4% implied probability, driven by their UMK national final triumph with the violin-pop fusion "Liekinheitin," dominating fan polls, bookie odds, and jury previews for broad jury-televote appeal. Greece's Akylas follows at 19.3% after winning Sing for Greece with edgy "Ferto"—bolstered by a new "Super Ferto" remix and Balkan-friendly projections—while Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund sits at 12.6% on his emotional Melodi Grand Prix ballad "Før Vi Går Hjem," though pre-party feedback tempered top-three hype. With all songs released and first rehearsals underway in Vienna ahead of May 12-16 semis and final, staging and live vocals will be pivotal swing factors in this fragmented field.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Boston Celtics hold home-court advantage in a winner-take-all Game 7 against the Philadelphia 76ers in their Eastern Conference first-round playoff series, tied 3-3 after Philly's decisive 106-93 Game 6 victory on Friday, where Tyrese Maxey erupted for 30 points amid a full team effort. The 76ers, now peaking with back-to-back road wins including Joel Embiid's 33-point dominance in Game 5 (113-97), have overcome Boston's early 2-1 lead despite the second seed's superior regular-season record (56-26 vs. 45-37). Official injury reports list Embiid as probable with an abdomen issue and Jayson Tatum expected to play after a Game 6 calf tweak, setting up a high-stakes clash hinging on execution, three-point shooting, and playoff poise at TD Garden.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player on either team achieves a Quadra Kill during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if no player achieves a Quadra Kill. A Penta Kill (5 kills in rapid succession) also counts as a Quadra Kill having occurred for the purposes of this market.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether a Quadra Kill occurred prior to stoppage. If no Quadra Kill occurred, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: Top Esports enters this LPL 2026 Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 as the clear trader favorite, holding second place with a 6-2 series record and 12-4 games tally amid strong regular season form, including recent wins over Ninjas in Pyjamas. Weibo Gaming, mired lower in standings around 2-5 series after a 1-2 loss to Invictus Gaming yesterday, gained momentum by sweeping Top Esports 2-0 just four days ago—their third win this split—highlighting Breathe and Xiaohu's macro edge in picks/bans. Head-to-head remains competitive (TES leads 11-6 overall), with no reported roster changes or injuries; double round-robin implications amplify pressure on TES to rebound while WBG eyes another upset in this high-stakes group stage clash.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices California Gov. Gavin Newsom as the frontrunner for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination at 26%, ahead of former Vice President Kamala Harris at 11%, due to his strong electability ratings in recent Echelon Insights polling and a commanding lead over Harris in a March California primary survey, signaling appeal in an early primary state. Harris garnered the warmest reception at April's National Action Network convention in New York, wooing Black voters—a pivotal bloc—while Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez rises on youth and progressive energy, and Sen. Jon Ossoff benefits from swing-state Georgia credentials. The wide-open post-2024 field could consolidate via 2026 midterm results, national fundraising tallies, or shifts in early caucus state hypotheticals amid reactions to the Trump administration.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Robert F. Kennedy Jr. at 49% to secure the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, narrowly ahead of Vice President J.D. Vance at 39%, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio at 21%, amid an open primary following President Trump's term limits. RFK Jr.'s lead stems from his high-profile HHS role driving Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) reforms, bolstered by April congressional testimony exposing Big Pharma ties that energized the MAGA base despite some MAHA voter disillusionment ahead of midterms. Vance holds as heir apparent via VP incumbency, while Rubio gains from recent CPAC straw poll surges and donor backing; 2026 midterm results could reshape frontrunner dynamics as traders weigh base appeal against establishment paths.

title: LoL: Invictus Gaming vs Anyone's Legend (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Invictus Gaming and Anyone's Legend in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 2 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Invictus Gaming" if Invictus Gaming win the match against Anyone's Legend.

This market will resolve to "Anyone's Legend" if Anyone's Legend win the match against Invictus Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 3: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 3. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Invictus Gaming and Anyone's Legend each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 3. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 3.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 3 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain Baron Nashor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 3 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: Anyone's Legend holds a commanding edge in trader consensus for their LPL 2026 Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 rematch against Invictus Gaming, driven by a dominant 2-0 sweep over IG just four days ago on April 28 and a fresh 2-0 upset win over Top Esports on May 1, propelling AL into the top three of Group Ascend standings with a strong 5-3 series record and +3 game differential. IG, mired in the lower half after recent losses to AL, JDG, and Weibo Gaming, struggles with inconsistent macro and laning, while AL's stable roster excels in current patch metas favoring aggressive early game pressure. Head-to-head history favors AL 7-1 over the past year, with playoff implications heightening stakes as top-four finishers advance directly; no major roster changes or substitutions reported.

title: LoL: Team WE vs JD Gaming (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Team WE and JD Gaming in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 2 at 3:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Team WE" if Team WE win the match against JD Gaming.

This market will resolve to "JD Gaming" if JD Gaming win the match against Team WE.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Following a fragile US-Iran ceasefire established in early April 2026 after escalations over the Strait of Hormuz blockade and regional proxy conflicts, diplomatic negotiations mediated by Pakistan have stalled amid unresolved demands. On May 1, President Trump publicly rejected Iran's latest proposal to reopen the Strait without restrictions or fees in exchange for lifting US sanctions, while deferring nuclear enrichment talks, calling the terms unacceptable. Iranian officials countered that US insistence on immediate atomic curbs blocks progress, maintaining a tense deadlock despite sub rosa efforts and foreign minister visits to Moscow and Islamabad. Trader consensus reflects ceasefire stability but deep historical mistrust, with congressional war powers resolutions looming as a potential catalyst for renewed hostilities or breakthroughs before June deadlines.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:
This market will resolve according to the listed driver that finishes 1st in the driver standings for the 2026 F1 season.

This market will resolve as soon as the official results of the final scheduled race of the 2026 F1 season are known.

If multiple drivers tie for first place in the drivers standings, this market will resolve according to the tiebreak procedure used by F1 to determine the 2026 F1 Drivers’ champion.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed driver to win the 2026 F1 Drivers Championship based on the rules of F1 (e.g., they are mathematically eliminated from contention), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the F1 season is permanently canceled or has not been completed by February 28, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Formula 1.

eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes' commanding early-2026 pace has locked teammates Kimi Antonelli and George Russell as Drivers' Championship frontrunners, with Antonelli leading standings at 72 points to Russell's 63 after six Grands Prix, including Antonelli's China and Japan triumphs overtaking Russell's Australian win. Trader consensus prices their near-parity—reflecting the wisdom of crowds on real-money wagers—stems from Russell's dominant qualifying head-to-head (22-5) and veteran consistency in races, offsetting Antonelli's rookie momentum amid Mercedes 1-2 finishes. Ferrari's Leclerc and McLaren's Norris trail meaningfully, Red Bull's Verstappen falters, while Miami GP practice gaps under a tenth highlight the intra-team duel defining this tight contest.

eventMetadata.context_description: Jack Della Maddalena, the former UFC welterweight champion with an 18-3 record, headlines UFC Fight Night in his hometown of Perth, Australia, facing surging knockout artist Carlos Prates (23-7) in a pivotal main event clash. Della Maddalena returns after a six-month layoff following a loss to Islam Makhachev in November 2025, potentially introducing rust against Prates' momentum from five finishes in his last six UFC bouts, including a stunning KO of ex-champ Leon Edwards last fall. Both made weight at 170 pounds yesterday with no reported injuries or withdrawals, setting up a stylistic battle of Della's high-volume striking and grappling versus Prates' power punching. Trader consensus reflects a razor-thin edge to Prates amid the close contest, factoring home-crowd energy for Della and Prates' recent KO streak, with no weather or late scratches impacting the card.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim trader consensus lead at 21.6% implied probability to win the 2028 presidential election, closely pursued by California Governor Gavin Newsom at 17.3%, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio at 10.7%, reflecting the fluid early-stage dynamics two years before primaries amid a fragmented field on both sides. Recent UMass Lowell polling from late March showed Vance edging Newsom 33%-30% head-to-head, while Echelon Insights data last week highlighted shifting Republican preferences toward Vance's donor outreach with top GOP billionaires and Rubio's elevated profile from foreign policy actions in Venezuela and Iran. The race remains tight due to untested national profiles, Trump administration performance metrics, and Democratic post-2024 disarray; 2026 midterms, potential Trump endorsements, and swing state polling could widen gaps.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil futures have exhibited sharp volatility this week, surging above $105 per barrel on the United Arab Emirates' announcement of its OPEC exit effective May 1—threatening coordinated supply discipline amid ongoing production cuts by the remaining OPEC+ members—before retreating to around $102 on hopes for a US-Iran ceasefire easing Middle East tensions. US crude inventories stand at 459.5 million barrels, marginally above the five-year seasonal average, signaling balanced but not oversupplied stockpiles. Weak global demand forecasts from the IEA, projecting an 80,000 bpd decline in 2026 amid economic slowdowns, cap upside potential. Traders eye weekly EIA inventory data releases and the IEA's May 13 Oil Market Report for near-term direction, with geopolitical risks in the Strait of Hormuz as key swing factors.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Post-municipal elections in late March 2026, trader consensus on Polymarket ties Jordan Bardella of Rassemblement National and centrist Édouard Philippe at 21.5% implied probability for the 2027 presidential winner, reflecting polls where Bardella leads the first round at 34-42% amid RN gains in smaller towns and voter desire for change, while Philippe scores 18-36% and narrowly wins runoffs (51-53% vs. Bardella). The race remains tight in this fragmented field—Les Républicains selected Bruno Retailleau on April 20, left lacks unity—with no dominant frontrunner one year before the April 2027 first round. Separation could arise from Marine Le Pen's summer appeal on her election ban, left-wing primaries, economic shifts, or candidate missteps.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 30 - May 2, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 30 12:00 PM ET to May 2, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: Trump announces US blockade of Hormuz lifted by...?
description:
On April 12, 2026, President Donald Trump announced that the United States will blockade the Strait of Hormuz. You can read more about that here: https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/live-blog/live-updates-us-iran-fail-reach-deal-peace-talks-day-negotiations-rcna315918.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the US military publicly and officially announces the end of the United States blockade of the Strait of Hormuz by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

Qualifying statements must clearly and explicitly indicate that the United States has lifted, ended, or will lift or end its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz on a specified date or use equivalently definitive language unambiguously signaling that such blockade has ceased or is set to cease on a specified date (e.g., statements unambiguously indicating that US naval activity in the relevant area has ceased will qualify). 

Statements that merely describe actions inconsistent with the blockade (e.g., "Iran resumed shipping through the Strait of Hormuz") without explicitly indicating the blockade as lifted will not alone suffice.

Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources, or leaks do not qualify.

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g., posts from his personal Truth Social account) will qualify. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

Note: this market will resolve solely based on whether a qualifying announcement is made within the specified timeframe. Whether the blockade is effectively enforced or whether maritime traffic resumes absent a qualifying announcement will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump imposed a US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz on April 12, 2026, after US-Iran peace talks collapsed in Pakistan, aiming to pressure Tehran amid stalled nuclear negotiations and prior Iranian restrictions on the waterway. The blockade persists despite Iran declaring the strait open and offering to fully reopen it in exchange for US withdrawal, a proposal Trump rejected two days ago, vowing to extend enforcement until a comprehensive deal. US forces have turned back dozens of vessels and seized Iranian ships, fueling a global energy crisis with surging oil prices. Recent diplomatic signals, including China's push for reopening during potential Trump-Xi talks, add uncertainty, while traders weigh mounting economic pressures against Trump's firm stance on no partial concessions.

title: US x Iran diplomatic meeting by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count. 

The meeting must be in-person and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Amid a fragile ceasefire following the 2026 US-Iran conflict, negotiations mediated by Pakistan remain stalled over Iran's nuclear program and the Strait of Hormuz blockade, with no direct diplomatic meeting between US and Iranian officials in the past month. Iran submitted a phased proposal on April 27—reopening the strait first and postponing nuclear talks—but President Trump expressed dissatisfaction yesterday, canceling planned in-person discussions in Islamabad and asserting US leverage. Russian involvement has emerged as a complicating factor. Traders weigh ongoing proposal reviews and potential national security council meetings against persistent red lines, with escalation risks if talks collapse before the market deadline.

title: Elon Musk # tweets May 1 - May 8, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from May 1 12:00 PM ET to May 8, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.
